tips.title: Compact before the context passes 150K
tips.finding: In 23 sessions the context grew past 150K tokens, and every request after that sent it again. Those requests cost $41.20, a third of the month.
advice: Run /compact when a session finishes one task and starts another.
Start a new session for unrelated work instead of carrying the old context along.
pros: Cheaper requests for the rest of the session.
Claude keeps its attention on the current task.
cons: The summary can drop a detail you needed later.
Compacting takes a minute on a large context.
tips.skipWhen: the session is about to end, or every earlier step matters for the next one.

metrics.label: Prompts per 100 requests

tips.title: Read parts of large files, not the whole file
tips.finding: Whole file reads of files over 2,000 lines added 4.1M tokens across 38 sessions. Most of them only needed a function or two.
advice: Ask Claude to grep for the symbol first and read only the lines around it.
Keep generated files out of the search path.
pros: Smaller context from the first prompt on.
cons: Claude can miss code outside the lines it read.
tips.skipWhen: you are reviewing the whole file on purpose.

tips.title: Stop a failing test loop sooner
tips.finding: In 6 sessions the same test failed more than 8 times in a row before anything changed.
advice: Tell Claude to stop and explain after 3 failed runs.
pros: Less spend on runs that teach nothing new.
cons: Some flaky tests do pass on the fourth try.
tips.skipWhen: the test is known to be flaky and you only want it green.

levers.title: Run routine work on Sonnet
levers.finding: 84% of the last week went to Opus, Fable or Mythos in main sessions. Changing this would have saved about $46 of $128.
advice: Start routine sessions (small fixes, tests, docs, landing work) on Sonnet with /model sonnet.
Use /model opusplan for bigger tasks: Opus plans, then Sonnet makes the edits.
Keep Opus for design work and bugs Sonnet has already failed to fix.

levers.title: Keep context small
levers.finding: Every request sends the whole context again. Context past 100K tokens is where this much went. Changing this would have saved about $22 of $128.
advice: Use /clear between tasks, and write a handoff note first when the task goes on.

levers.title: Run subagents on a cheaper model
levers.finding: Subagents used 18% of the last week, much of it on premium models. Changing this would have saved about $9.40 of $128.
advice: Set CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL to sonnet in Knobs, or give your own agents model: sonnet.
